items.headline: Holiday Extras uses OpenAI Codex to develop customer applications
items.summary: Holiday Extras is using OpenAI Codex to build applications, improve booking conversions, and create growth opportunities based on its customer expertise.
items.why_it_matters: The company is leveraging Codex to convert customer knowledge into improved software applications.
items.evidence_quote: With Codex, Holiday Extras is turning customer expertise into better apps, higher booking conversion and new possibilities for growth.

items.headline: OpenAI pledges $2 million for research into AI and child safety
items.summary: OpenAI has committed $2 million to fund research focusing on AI and children's safety. The funds will help develop shared tools to assess potential risks and benefits for young users.
items.why_it_matters: The investment funds research to build shared tools for evaluating how AI impacts children.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety.

items.headline: Phota Labs launches AI-powered photo editing platform
items.summary: Phota Labs is utilising artificial intelligence to automate the image editing process, aiming to convert everyday pictures into professional-quality photographs.
items.why_it_matters: The technology automates photo editing tasks to simplify image enhancement for consumers.
items.evidence_quote: Phota Labs aims to use advances in AI to automate the editing process so it’s easier for anyone to turn everyday moments into better photos.

items.headline: Nvidia expands GeForce NOW cloud service and DLSS 5 support
items.summary: Nvidia has announced that Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV is coming to its GeForce NOW cloud gaming platform. Additionally, NVIDIA DLSS 5 technology will be integrated into War Thunder and Where Winds Meet.
items.why_it_matters: Nvidia is introducing DLSS 5 technology to select titles alongside expanding its cloud gaming library.
items.evidence_quote: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV is coming to GeForce NOW, allowing players to experience the battle for Kronus through cloud gaming.
